# GCP OWASP Top 10 Skills

Source: https://github.com/hminooei/gcp-owasp-top10-skills/blob/main/README.md

# GCP OWASP Top 10 Skills

A Gemini CLI extension providing 10 agent skills for auditing and remediating [OWASP Top 10 2021](https://owasp.org/Top10/) vulnerabilities on Google Cloud Platform, based on [Google's official mitigation guidance](https://cloud.google.com/architecture/security/owasp-top-ten-mitigation).

## Installation

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/hminooei/gcp-owasp-top10-skills
```

## Prerequisites

- [Google Cloud SDK](https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/install) (`gcloud`) installed and authenticated
- An active GCP project: `gcloud config set project PROJECT_ID`
- Appropriate IAM permissions (varies per skill, documented in each SKILL.md)

## Skills

| Skill | OWASP Category | What It Does |
|-------|---------------|-------------|
| `gcp-broken-access-control` | A01: Broken Access Control | Audit IAM policies, Cloud Armor WAF, IAP, SCC findings, SSL policies, asset inventory |
| `gcp-cryptographic-failures` | A02: Cryptographic Failures | Audit KMS keys, Secret Manager, TLS configuration, DLP scanning |
| `gcp-injection` | A03: Injection | Audit/deploy Cloud Armor WAF rules for SQLi, XSS, RCE, PHP injection |
| `gcp-insecure-design` | A04: Insecure Design | Audit API validation, DLP exposure, secure design patterns |
| `gcp-security-misconfiguration` | A05: Security Misconfiguration | Audit misconfigurations, admin endpoints, deploy hardening rules |
| `gcp-vulnerable-components` | A06: Vulnerable Components | Audit Binary Authorization, container images, SCC threat findings |
| `gcp-auth-failures` | A07: Auth Failures | Audit authentication config, MFA status, deploy rate limiting |
| `gcp-integrity-failures` | A08: Integrity Failures | Audit Artifact Registry, Binary Authorization, Cloud Build pipelines |
| `gcp-logging-monitoring-failures` | A09: Logging & Monitoring | Audit logging config, monitoring alerts, SCC integration |
| `gcp-ssrf` | A10: SSRF | Audit VPC firewalls, VPC Service Controls, deploy SSRF protection rules |

## Usage Examples

Skills activate automatically based on your prompts:

- "Audit my GCP project for broken access control vulnerabilities"
- "Set up Cloud Armor WAF rules to block SQL injection"
- "Check if Identity-Aware Proxy is enabled on my backend services"
- "Review my KMS key rotation policies"
- "Are there any Security Command Center findings for my project?"
- "Harden my VPC firewall rules against SSRF attacks"
- "Check if Binary Authorization is enforced on my GKE clusters"
- "Set up logging and monitoring for security events"

## Script Inventory

Each skill includes bash scripts that use `gcloud` CLI commands. All scripts:
- Accept `PROJECT_ID` as the first argument
- Exit with code 0 (pass) or 1 (findings detected)
- Produce structured, human-readable output
- Are idempotent (remediation scripts check before creating)

### Audit Scripts
| Script | Skill | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `audit-iam-policies.sh` | A01 | Find public access bindings and primitive roles |
| `audit-cloud-armor.sh` | A01 | Inventory policies, find unprotected backends |
| `audit-iap-status.sh` | A01 | Check IAP enablement per backend service |
| `audit-scc-findings.sh` | A01 | Pull access-control SCC findings |
| `audit-ssl-policies.sh` | A01 | Flag weak TLS/cipher configurations |
| `audit-asset-inventory.sh` | A01 | Check for asset change monitoring feeds |
| `audit-kms-keys.sh` | A02 | Audit key rotation and algorithm strength |
| `audit-secrets.sh` | A02 | Check Secret Manager access and rotation |
| `audit-tls-config.sh` | A02 | Audit SSL policies and certificate expiry |
| `audit-dlp-scan.sh` | A02 | Check DLP scanning configuration |
| `audit-cloud-armor-waf.sh` | A03 | Check for injection protection WAF rules |
| `audit-scc-injection.sh` | A03 | Pull injection-related SCC findings |
| `audit-api-validation.sh` | A04 | Check API validation and Apigee config |
| `audit-dlp-exposure.sh` | A04 | Check for sensitive data exposure scanning |
| `audit-misconfigurations.sh` | A05 | Find common security misconfigurations |
| `audit-admin-endpoints.sh` | A05 | Check for exposed admin/management paths |
| `audit-binary-auth.sh` | A06 | Audit Binary Authorization on GKE |
| `audit-container-images.sh` | A06 | Check container vulnerability scanning |
| `audit-security-bulletins.sh` | A06 | Pull container threat findings from SCC |
| `audit-auth-config.sh` | A07 | Audit IAP, Identity Platform, reCAPTCHA |
| `audit-mfa-status.sh` | A07 | Check MFA enforcement and key age |
| `audit-artifact-registry.sh` | A08 | Audit Artifact Registry and scanning APIs |
| `audit-binary-authorization.sh` | A08 | Audit Binary Authorization policy |
| `audit-cloud-build.sh` | A08 | Audit Cloud Build pipeline security |
| `audit-logging-config.sh` | A09 | Audit log sinks, retention, metrics |
| `audit-monitoring-alerts.sh` | A09 | Check alerting policies and channels |
| `audit-scc-integration.sh` | A09 | Check SCC notification configuration |
| `audit-vpc-firewall.sh` | A10 | Audit egress rules and metadata protection |
| `audit-vpc-service-controls.sh` | A10 | Check VPC Service Controls perimeters |

### Remediation Scripts
| Script | Skill | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `remediate-cloud-armor.sh` | A01 | Deploy CORS, LFI, RFI, parameter pollution rules |
| `remediate-injection-rules.sh` | A03 | Deploy SQLi, XSS, RCE, PHP injection rules |
| `remediate-misconfiguration.sh` | A05 | Deploy method enforcement, scanner detection rules |
| `remediate-rate-limiting.sh` | A07 | Configure brute force rate limiting |
| `remediate-ssrf-rules.sh` | A10 | Deploy SSRF protection rules |

## Important Notes

- These skills cover **infrastructure-layer controls** using GCP services
- Many vulnerabilities also require **application-level fixes** that cannot be addressed through infrastructure alone
- Always test remediation scripts in a non-production environment first
- Review Cloud Armor rules and firewall changes before applying to production

## References

- [OWASP Top 10 2021](https://owasp.org/Top10/)
- [OWASP Top 10 mitigation options on Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/architecture/security/owasp-top-ten-mitigation)
- [Cloud Armor documentation](https://cloud.google.com/armor/docs)
- [Identity-Aware Proxy documentation](https://cloud.google.com/iap/docs)
- [Security Command Center documentation](https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs)

# GCP OWASP Top 10 Skills

Source: https://github.com/hminooei/gcp-owasp-top10-skills/blob/main/GEMINI.md

# GCP OWASP Top 10 Skills

This extension provides 10 specialized skills for auditing and remediating OWASP Top 10 2021 vulnerabilities on Google Cloud Platform, based on Google's official mitigation guidance.

## Prerequisites

- Google Cloud SDK (`gcloud`) installed and authenticated
- Appropriate IAM permissions for the target project (varies by skill)
- Active GCP project: `gcloud config set project PROJECT_ID`

## Important

These skills cover **infrastructure-layer controls** using GCP services. Many vulnerabilities also require **application-level fixes** (input validation, authorization logic, session management) that cannot be addressed through infrastructure alone. Always pair these controls with proper application-level security.

## Skills

| Skill | OWASP Category |
|-------|---------------|
| gcp-broken-access-control | A01: Broken Access Control |
| gcp-cryptographic-failures | A02: Cryptographic Failures |
| gcp-injection | A03: Injection |
| gcp-insecure-design | A04: Insecure Design |
| gcp-security-misconfiguration | A05: Security Misconfiguration |
| gcp-vulnerable-components | A06: Vulnerable and Outdated Components |
| gcp-auth-failures | A07: Identification and Authentication Failures |
| gcp-integrity-failures | A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures |
| gcp-logging-monitoring-failures | A09: Logging and Monitoring Failures |
| gcp-ssrf | A10: Server-Side Request Forgery |
